entities.summary: Albertus Christiaan "Hans" van Swol was a Dutch tennis player. He was five-fold Dutch singles champion. He reached the fourth round at Wimbledon on five occasions but never made it to the quarter finals stage. He reached the third round of the French Championships at Roland-Garros in 1937.
